evals.prompt: I need RSA copy for my Google Ads campaign. We sell project management software called TaskFlow — it's aimed at marketing agencies that are juggling 10+ client projects and losing track of deadlines. Our main differentiators are a visual timeline view, automated client reporting, and we're the only tool with built-in time tracking + invoicing. Keywords for this ad group are around 'project management software for agencies'. We're offering a free 14-day trial, no credit card needed. Landing page: https://www.teamwork.com
evals.expected_output: 15 headlines (all ≤30 chars), 4 descriptions (all ≤90 chars), covering all 6 thematic categories, with an Ad Strength assessment, pinning recommendations, and a saved .xlsx file

evals.prompt: Can you write Google Ads copy for my plumbing business? We're based in Austin TX, we do emergency plumbing — burst pipes, blocked drains, gas leaks. We're available 24/7 and we guarantee to arrive in 60 minutes or less. Our competitors mostly advertise on price but we're positioning on speed and reliability. We don't have a website yet so no URL. Target keywords: 'emergency plumber Austin', '24 hour plumber Austin'
evals.expected_output: 15 headlines (all ≤30 chars), 4 descriptions (all ≤90 chars), with strong urgency and local signals, covering all 6 categories, plus strategic notes and .xlsx output
